description: This file implements Unix domain socket transport for D-Bus communication, including message reading, writing, and handling of Unix file descriptors.

classes.name: msghead
classes.description: Represents the fixed part of a message header with byte order and size fields.

classes.name: oobReader
classes.description: Handles reading messages with out-of-band data from a Unix domain socket.

classes.name: unixTransport
classes.description: Manages Unix socket transport, including message sending and receiving, with support for Unix FDs.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data and out-of-band data from the Unix socket connection.

methods.name: EnableUnixFDs
methods.description: Enables passing Unix file descriptors over the transport.

methods.name: ReadMessage
methods.description: Reads a message from the Unix socket, including headers, body, and optional Unix FDs.

methods.name: SendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message over the Unix socket, including optional Unix FDs.

methods.name: SupportsUnixFDs
methods.description: Indicates whether Unix FDs are supported on this transport.
